prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the front end shows the bumper cover cracked across the center, the grille mount broken, and the hood leading edge bent upward, with the radiator support and both headlamp brackets displaced. The damage pattern is consistent with the reported head-on impact at low speed, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records reviewed. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, grille, and hood, along with straightening the radiator support and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours submitted fit the damage described. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently being checked against the shop invoices before final approval.
